article.title: Perguntar + interrogativo
article.part: Relativas, condicionales y discurso referido — Relativas, condicionais e discurso relatado
article.chapter: Discurso directo, indirecto y secuencia temporal — Discurso direto, indireto e sequência temporal

claims.sectionKey: Perguntar + interrogativo permite reportar preguntas parciales
claims.summary: The interrogative word allows reporting partial questions, i.e., questions that request specific information.

claims.sectionKey: La elección temporal y pronominal depende del punto de vista del reporte
claims.summary: The choice of temporal and pronominal depends on the reporter's point of view, not on a word-for-word conversion.

claims.sectionKey: No se añade normalmente se cuando ya hay un interrogativo que introduce la pregunta parcial
claims.summary: The word 'se' is not normally added when there is already an interrogative that introduces the partial question.

links.notes: The source explicitly states that interrogative words allow reporting partial questions, which matches the claim in the article.
The source explains that the choice of temporal and pronominal depends on the reporter's perspective, which aligns with the claim in the article.
The source clarifies that 'se' is not added when there is already an interrogative introducing the partial question, which matches the claim in the article.
